title: Abyss Glow
description: Dangle a lure, hire deeply bureaucratic sea creatures, and dive through seven named depth zones and whatever the Bottom Drawer is hiding, if your cardigan can take the pressure.

medals.bronze: Ratify The Krill Accord, your first treaty
medals.silver: Pass four treaties, up to The Abyssal Convention
medals.gold: Pass all six treaties, down to Article Zero
medals.platinum: Amend every treaty, knit the cardigan, and reach To Whom It May Concern

title: Anvil & Ember
description: Work the bellows, keep the rhythm and forge legendary blades for heroes who will definitely pay you next week.

medals.bronze: Earn your first mastery, Knows Which End Is Hot
medals.silver: Earn three masteries, up to Reads the Colours
medals.gold: Earn all five masteries and be declared Hero-Proof
medals.platinum: Forge every legendary blade, strike 40,000 perfect blows, make 2,000 masterworks and land 20 perfect blows in a row

title: Boo & Breakfast
description: Rattle chains, hire a passive-aggressive poltergeist, greet the spectral guests of your haunted bed and breakfast, then open the West Wing and survive the Witching Hour.

medals.bronze: Open The Cursed Ledger, your first mastery
medals.silver: Earn three masteries, up to Promoted to Night Manager
medals.gold: Earn all five masteries, ending with Four Skulls and a Rosette
medals.platinum: Finish the West Wing and earn Nine Skulls and No Survivors

title: Bumble Empire
description: Tap flowers, appoint absurdly titled bees, and rule the meadow through four seasons. Winter halts all foraging, the Treasury pays handsome interest, and an Empire awaits past the fence.

medals.bronze: Sign The Royal Charter, your first decree
medals.silver: Sign three decrees, up to The Hexagonal Constitution
medals.gold: Sign all five decrees and proclaim the Bumble Empire
medals.platinum: See off five swarms, annex every Dominion, close 200 winters with a full vault

title: Coin Clicker 2.0
description: Click for coins, hire helpers, unlock 200 achievements, then melt it all down for the Great Work, earning even while you are away.

medals.bronze: Found the Guild Charter, your first mastery
medals.silver: Earn three masteries, up to the Royal Patent
medals.gold: Earn all four masteries and hold the Philosopher's Stone
medals.platinum: Finish the Great Work, hold every royal warrant, and recoin the realm 8 times

title: Dino Donuts
description: Fry donuts with a staff of badly suited dinosaurs, race prehistoric customers' deadlines, ride your order streak to the meteor, then dig its crater through every age after it.

medals.bronze: Bribe the Health Inspector, your first mastery
medals.silver: Earn three masteries, up to the Mating Call Jukebox
medals.gold: Earn all five masteries and learn The Meteor Is a Donut
medals.platinum: Ring in every age to the Holocene, with all regulars and crew on board

title: Glam Clicker
description: Swipe lipstick for sparkles, hire googly-eyed makeup helpers, glow up while you are away, then take your signature looks down the runway.

medals.bronze: Master the Flawless Winged Liner, your first mastery
medals.silver: Earn three masteries, up to No-Makeup Makeup
medals.gold: Earn all five masteries and become a Certified Beauty Icon
medals.platinum: Set every look, walk every runway, sign every deal, unveil your wax figure

title: Neon Arcade
description: Slam the big button, hire sentient pinball machines, and let one 1980s arcade swallow the whole city. Game over? Insert a Continue Token and do it all again, faster, until the Kill Screen opens and the garbage starts hiring.

medals.bronze: Master Frame-Perfect Thumbs in any run
medals.silver: Hold three masteries in one run, up to Beat Both Steves
medals.gold: Hold all five masteries in one run, up to the Kill Screen
medals.platinum: Fix Level 256: every DIP switch, every ROM patch, 256 Multiballs, a record score

title: Parrot Plunder
description: The parrots took the ship. Dig up doubloons on a sunny beach, hire a very feathery crew, and send ships off to dubious islands for treasure and curious keepsakes. Then amend the constitution, loudly, and survey the sea you now own.

medals.bronze: Ratify Article I: All Crackers Are Shared
medals.silver: Ratify three Articles, up to No Humans Below Deck
medals.gold: Ratify all five Articles, up to The Sky Was Ours All Along
medals.platinum: Pass every Amendment, finish the Grand Survey, sign on 25 of each Far Sea bird

title: Petal Pushers
description: Arrange bouquets against the clock for customers who are sorry, but not too sorry, then grow a corner florist into a floral empire.

medals.bronze: Earn your first Guild certificate, and know a hyacinth from a hole in the ground
medals.silver: Earn three certificates, and become Confidante to the Whole Town
medals.gold: Earn all five certificates, and become Grand Florist of the Realm
medals.platinum: Hand-tie 5,000 Perfect bouquets, serve a streak of 50, breed every hybrid, beat the whole Flower Show and open every branch

title: Potion Commotion
description: Stir a chaotic witches' apothecary, overwork a toad on a performance plan, throw things in the cauldron until some of them turn out to be recipes, then face the Board: patients, a cellar, and a museum of your mistakes.

medals.bronze: Earn your Mail-Order Witchcraft Diploma, your first degree
medals.silver: Earn four degrees, up to Tenure at the Invisible College
medals.gold: Earn all six degrees and become Keeper of the Last Ladle
medals.platinum: Complete the toad's performance plan: patients, vintages, regrets and both books

title: Rise & Shine
description: Juggle temperamental ovens, pull every bake at its golden moment, appease a sourdough starter with opinions, and take the County Fair from a very smug rival.

medals.bronze: Earn your first mastery, Flour Behind the Ears
medals.silver: Earn three masteries, up to Mildred's Blessing
medals.gold: Earn all five masteries and see in The Golden Hour
medals.platinum: Win every County Fair class, finish the Market Square, three-star every recipe, and rack up a mountain of golden pulls and perfect folds

title: The Lucky Pint
description: Pour pints, hire a sheep to tend bar, and crawl your merry way around all of Ireland.

medals.bronze: Kiss the Blarney Stone, your first mastery
medals.silver: Earn three masteries, up to All-Ireland Pint Champion
medals.gold: Earn all five masteries and become Patron Saint of Pints
medals.platinum: Finish the Crawl, top off 3,000 perfect pints and be High King of Pints

title: Top Spin
description: Play real table tennis rallies, from a warped table in a damp basement to the World Finals, while your club quietly earns behind you. The sport takes itself very seriously, so someone should.

medals.bronze: Laminate your membership card, your first mastery
medals.silver: Earn three masteries, up to County Colours
medals.gold: Earn all five masteries and be issued the Federation Blazer
medals.platinum: Finish the World Tour, close 5 seasons, research every bat, and land 50,000 perfect returns with a streak of 75

title: Whisker Station
description: A space station run entirely by cats. Pet the station cat, hire zero-gravity kittens, decide exactly when to unleash the zoomies, then follow The Great Nap Theorem to the edge of the Cosmic Shelf.

medals.bronze: Join the Order of the Warm Laundry, your first mastery
medals.silver: Earn three masteries, up to the Treaty of the Top Shelf
medals.gold: Earn all five masteries and prove The Great Nap Theorem
medals.platinum: Clear the Cosmic Shelf, prove every corollary and toast all twelve decks
